q1_issues.issue: A bare postural 'sat' clause mints no event whatever its verb, and tense alone is not a reification trigger (no progressive morphology, manner adverb, time modifier or connective endpoint is present), so sk_sit_1 and its Experiencer/Location/Past atoms are an unlicensed event.

The position should be entity-attached and tense-wrapped — (Past (RightBehind edmundo melissa)) — rather than an oblique on a minted sit event, with 'in class' likewise taking the containment head on the entity.

q2_gaps: degree modifier on a spatial preposition ('right behind'): the CamelCase multi-word-preposition rule covers 'next to' / 'across the lane from', but nothing says how to carry an intensifier over a preposition
notes: Had the event route been triggered, Experiencer for the postural subject and Location with bare constant 'class' would be exactly right — the defect is the routing, not the roles. RightBehind is counted as licensed since an event-side oblique may be named after its own surface preposition.
